name: Camper Van
summary: Rounded retro two-tone camper van with curtains in the windows, side view facing right; for road-trip scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the tyres stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 710 px wide and 380 px tall at s = 1

params.name: color
params.note: lower body colour; the upper half is white

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = wheels spin and the van bounces (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the front faces left

author: krakujs
